parts.title: Energy-feasible UAV exploration over an online registry of safe landing zones
parts.lead: Demonstration missions: PX4 SITL, Gazebo Harmonic and ROS 2, shown in RViz

ul: Each flight is shown next to {b|its own energy chart}, drawn from the mission log
These are {b|demonstrations}, not measurements: the display slows the simulation, so a filmed mission is charged more energy than a measured one

blocks.p: Dorian Veloso  ·  Capstone B  ·  University of Technology Sydney  ·  2026

parts.title: Reading the picture

legend: {margin|Light green}: sound, but too close to a refused cell for the 1.5 m footprint
{refused|Red}: refused, slope, roughness or step over its threshold
{unseen|Grey}: not yet seen well enough to judge
{conf|Green}: confirmed, seen from two passes; C1 may rely on it
{takeoff|Blue}: the take-off point, a provisional zone
{c1red|Red}: frontier refused by C1, its return would not be affordable
{need|Black}: what the return, the landing and the reserve need (I1)
{refused|Red band}: margin below zero, the invariant is violated

7.  The effect of α
parts.lead: Same world (W2), same 48 kJ budget, same take-off point: only α changes

blocks.p: C2 ranks the frontiers C1 admits by   U = α · {gain|G} + (1 − α) · {marg|M}

ul: {gain|G}, information gain: the unknown cells a frontier would reveal
{marg|M}, energy margin: what would be left after going there and coming back
α = 0.1 leans on the {marg|margin}, α = 0.9 on the {gain|gain}
One flight per value: a SITL mission never repeats exactly, so the measured campaign follows the maps

parts.title: 8.  Losing part of the zone in use (evaluated code)

ul: A field of crates is dropped on the zone the return flies to, 31 m before it arrives
The zone survives through its other cells, so {b|no loss is detected}
The return flies on to its original end and commits the landing {refused|among the crates}
A gap found while filming, reported in Section 6.6; shown in real time

blocks.p: Filmed on 31 October with the heavier display: its map is noisier than in the measured missions

What the report measures

ul: No mission with C1 violated the invariant: {conf|0 of 150}, against {refused|30 of 30} for B0 and {refused|11 of 30} for B1
Every B0 mission ran out of energy in flight: {crash|30 crashes} on a real battery
The energy C1 charged exceeded the energy measured in {b|2530 of 2535} transits
Coverage peaks for α between {b|0.5 and 0.75}; the landing area found grows with α
